description: This file defines the class PdfEmbeddedFileStream, which represents an embedded file stream in PDF documents, including methods for initialization, property setting, and type checking.

classes.name: PdfEmbeddedFileStream
classes.description: Represents an embedded file stream within a PDF document, providing initialization, type identification, and related key definitions.

classes.name: PdfEmbeddedFileStream.Keys
classes.description: Contains the predefined keys used in the PdfEmbeddedFileStream dictionary, such as Type, Subtype, and Params.

methods.name: PdfEmbeddedFileStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an embedded file stream object from a PDF document and a data stream.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the dictionary entries for the embedded file stream after data is loaded.

methods.name: IsEmbeddedFile
methods.description: Static method to check if a given PDF dictionary is an embedded file stream based on its Type value.
